[[Rend Ragemauler]] was one of the [[Charr]] who led the invasion of [[Ascalon]]. He persuaded [[Anton]] into betraying Ascalon in exchange for lives of his friends and family from his village.  During the invasion of [[Surmia]] Rend Ragemauler backstabbed Anton and killed those he was supposed to spare.  

It is not known whether Rend Ragemauler belonged to the [[Flame Legion]] (his location[s] places him in close proximity to them) or the hypothetical Rage warband.
